summary: 52-year-old woman slipped on loose gravel on the Silvershield Trail and rolled an ankle. OMRT secured a helicopter with a marginal landing zone half a mile up the trail, fashioned a wheeled litter, and hauled her to the helicopter for a flight to Ouray.
